objective: Give Micronaut a persistent, domain-neutral Study map that establishes the user's experiment before detailed editing, clarifies Study -> Measurements -> per-measurement planning, recommends the next consequential decision, and preserves all existing offline, provenance, assay-tier, and export-safety contracts.
global_invariants: Do not rename the persisted assays array, assay ids, assayView(), scopeWrite(), or assay-scoped provenance keys; Measurement is a presentation term.
Do not add a dependency, server, account, cloud call, framework, forced route guard, or scientific-validity claim.
All state writes continue through the existing store/provenance/autosave machinery; no UI module writes localStorage project data directly.
The pure experiment-map projection is the only owner of next-decision ordering; the shell, Home, and Review consume it.
Decision tier never changes conformance severity or export permission; the existing fresh conformance report remains the final-artifact gate.
Executors inspect the dirty tree first, preserve unrelated/user changes, run focused tests plus the full JavaScript suite, and never commit or push.

tasks.title: Add the v5 study-context persistence contract
tasks.scope: Advance SCHEMA_VERSION from 4 to 5. Add studyContext {system:'', experimentalUnit:'', comparisonMode:'not-decided'} to emptyExperiment(). Define and export the allowed comparison-mode vocabulary. Add a total v4->v5 migration that supplies only empty/default context and never infers from prose, group vocabulary, assay specimen, or example strings. Normalize malformed current-version studyContext values at the migration boundary without deleting other current data. Preserve v1->v4 migrations, meta.origin behavior, assay identities, assay slices, naming templates, provenance, and no-op identity for already-valid v5 objects where the existing migrate contract requires it.
tasks.verification: Update schema tests with generated v1-v4 fixtures: migrate each to v5 and assert the new context defaults plus byte-equivalent legacy assay/design/naming/provenance slices. Test every allowed comparison mode, malformed/missing context normalization, unsupported future version rejection, and emptyExperiment defaults. Run `node --test web/tests/schema.test.js web/tests/assay.test.js web/tests/persist.test.js`, then `node --test web/tests/*.test.js`.

tasks.verification: Update default-study tests to assert exact seeded context, weak provenance, unchanged four-assay content, and that emptyExperiment/imported legacy studies do not receive oregano values. tasks.title: Build the pure experiment-map and next-decision projection
tasks.scope: Create engine/experimentMap.js as the only UI-neutral authority for the Study map described in the prose plan. Project question, system, comparison mode/groups, experimental unit, and measurement summaries from the real schema without mutating it. Produce fixed missing/provisional/answered/needs-attention states, ordered decision objects with routeId and optional measurementId, deterministic orientation progress, and one nextDecision. Treat observational comparison as answered without groups; require group labels only for mode=groups. A measurement is defined when it has a nonblank label plus a recognized readout or nonblank readoutText; do not require multiple measurements. Use assay ids, never array indices, in decision destinations. Accept optional existing workflow/conformance inputs, but remain total for malformed/partial studies.
tasks.verification: Add experimentMap tests covering an empty v5 study, the seeded example, groups vs observational branches, skipped/provisional fields, multiple measurements with different readiness, missing biological replicate decision, missing modality, conformance-derived issues, stale/unknown assay ids, and malformed data. Assert the exact decision order and that repeated calls are deep-equal and do not mutate input. Include plant, soil/material, and surface-characterization fixtures to prove no biology-specific inference. Run `node --test web/tests/experimentMap.test.js web/tests/assay.test.js web/tests/workflowProgress.test.js`, then the full JS suite.

tasks.title: Classify outstanding decisions by scientific consequence
tasks.scope: Create engine/decisionTriage.js. Combine experiment-map decisions and existing conformance issues into the four fixed tiers: study-shape, measurement-design, before-acquisition, later. Classify by canonical field/section identity, never by user-facing message substring. Preserve original issue severity, section, assay id, and route. Blocking remains blocking even if its ordinary timing tier would be later. Return stable ordered groups and counts; do not modify checkConformance(), compute export permission, or claim scientific validity.
tasks.verification: Add a truth-table test for every currently emitted conformance section/field class plus the new study-context decisions. Explicitly prove: missing experimental unit -> study-shape; missing biological replicates -> measurement-design; panel/path conflict -> before-acquisition; placeholder date/sample id -> later; invalid date/path retains blocking severity. Assert no input mutation and deterministic order. Run `node --test web/tests/decisionTriage.test.js web/tests/conformance.test.js`, then the full JS suite.

tasks.title: Make workflow progress carry the Study map and coherent labels
tasks.scope: Update workflowProgress.js to expose the new visible route labels: Study map, Research brief, Measurements, Samples & design, Acquisition, Data plan, Review. Keep route ids and panel/microscopy alias stable. Consume buildExperimentMap() and include its projection in the returned progress object so main/shell/Home/Review share one snapshot. Home/Study-map progress reflects orientation state rather than being permanently complete. Keep the existing per-measurement project/design/microscopy/naming/readiness computations unless a map decision directly supplies the same fact; do not duplicate next-decision ordering or conformance severity.
tasks.verification: Update workflow-progress tests for empty, partially oriented, observational, multi-measurement, needs-attention, and ready studies. Assert exact labels/route ids, map object identity-by-value, Study-map progress transitions, existing per-assay state behavior, Guide exclusion, and no second next-decision calculation. Run `node --test web/tests/workflowProgress.test.js web/tests/experimentMap.test.js web/tests/conformance.test.js`, then the full JS suite.

tasks.title: Create the reusable Study-map intake and summary component
tasks.scope: Add ui/studyMap.js, a DOM-only component that consumes the pure map plus the existing store/router contracts. Render two modes in the same region: orientation intake when consequential study-shape answers are missing, and editable map summary otherwise. Write question/system/context/group/measurement data only through store.setPath/store.patch with user provenance; create measurements via the existing id and seedAssayFromVocabulary helpers in one atomic patch. The component must consume map.nextDecision rather than recreate priority. When routing a measurement decision, validate the id, patch activeAssayId first, then navigate. Do not read/write localStorage or call a model.
tasks.verification: Add pure helper tests only where state transitions can be extracted without a DOM framework. Build the single file and manually drive: reload after every answer, groups and observational branches, Decide later, back/forward, add two measurements without duplicates, edit map answers, stale deleted measurement destination safe no-op, and keyboard labels/focus. Snapshot store.get() before/after each action to prove only intended schema/provenance paths change. Run relevant schema/assay/store/experimentMap tests and the full JS suite, then build.

tasks.verification: Against a fresh built artifact, trace no-save first run, recovered user work, example exploration, template adoption, blank start, guided walkthrough start/resume/restart, and reload.
